location.manager_interpretation: Relative location disadvantage vs labelled peers.
location.possible_mitigation: Communicate transport access; cannot physically relocate.
location.reason: Site/geography is not a short-run operational lever.

cleanliness.manager_interpretation: Housekeeping / hygiene quality signals in reviews.
cleanliness.possible_mitigation: Housekeeping standards, inspection cadence, deep-clean schedule.

noise.possible_mitigation: Soft furnishings, window seals, room assignment; some external noise is constrained.
noise.reason: Partly controllable; external traffic/neighbours may limit impact.

room.possible_mitigation: Maintenance, soft renovation, amenity packs; full refurbish is capital-heavy.
room.reason: Some fixes are operational; structural room size is constrained.

value.possible_mitigation: Pricing, packages, included amenities; not only 'quality'.
value.reason: Mix of pricing and quality levers.
